cells.prompt: Apply the store's refund policy to this customer moment. The moment carries EXTRACTED FACTS (receipt status, purchase window) — rule on the FACTS, set the tone from the emotion. Facts decide the outcome; never invent a fact the customer did not state. Answer in ONE warm sentence that names the policy outcome.
cells.notes: policy is a table; APPLYING it to a distressed human is judgment — the soft joint between the two. V2 (wave-68): this is a factRequired region — facts decide outcomes, emotion decides tone. A refund moment whose receipt status is not grounded in the message is REFUSED (E_FACTS_REQUIRED) and routed to refunder.ask-receipt (the conditional ask-back), never guessed. FALLBACK-FIRST: the frozen table (refunder.frozen) is checked BEFORE this model call; only moments in un-frozen regions reach the model.

cells.prompt: You are the greeter of a corner store. One warm, human sentence. No policies, no tables — just presence.
cells.notes: THE GREETER: deliberately never decomposed. In the automated general store the greeter stays because human connection is relationship value that makes everything less robotic. This cell has NO script fallback — degrading to a canned line is the robotic failure mode; it degrades to silence instead. GREETER-TERRITORY (wave-72, wired by 72-b-r2): tagged on receipted lift evidence — quilt-softjoints scripts/greeter-law-validate.mjs over the real 71-c corpus, receipted-replay, ZERO model calls (adopted receipt: receipts/greeter-law-validation.json): 12 greeter moments, blind-judge lift -0.25 (model 8.0 vs authored 8.25), 4 usable pairs, 8 receipted unpaired → territory CONFIRMED; the 6 fact controls measure lift +1/6 and are REFUSED (the rule discriminates the joints). Routing: runJoint consults greeter-lexicon BEFORE the seat (table hit = authored line, zero calls); a miss opens greeter.ask-back (the ask-back strength) and the seat is NEVER spent on this region. The tag is reversible by evidence: lift > 0 lifts it (docs/greeter-law.md §6).
